Set character limits and overlap, then read the chunks returned with the extraction result.

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val input = mapper.readValue("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/text/book_war_and_peace_1p.txt\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"chunking\":{\"chunker_type\":\"text\",\"max_chars\":300,\"max_overlap\":40,\"trim\":true}}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extract(input, config)
    println(result.results.first().chunks)
}
```
